glossary.name: Avengers
glossary.summary: A Hero team. Its icon powers team Superpower abilities.

glossary.name: X-Men
glossary.summary: A Hero team. Its icon powers team Superpower abilities.

glossary.name: Covert
glossary.summary: Red Heroes who win through trickery, planning and subtle Superpowers.

glossary.name: Instinct
glossary.summary: Yellow Heroes who rely on savagery, quick reflexes and sharp senses.

glossary.name: Ranged
glossary.summary: Blue Heroes who unleash firepower: projectiles, energy beams, elemental force and mental assaults.

glossary.name: Strength
glossary.summary: Green Heroes with raw power, determination and strong leadership.

glossary.name: Tech
glossary.summary: Black Heroes who rely on weapons, gadgets, inventions and advanced science.

glossary.name: Always Leads
glossary.summary: Names the Villain or Henchman Group a Mastermind brings along. That group is one of the groups added to the Villain Deck.

glossary.name: Ambush
glossary.summary: A Villain effect that happens as soon as the Villain enters the city.

glossary.name: Escape
glossary.summary: A Villain effect that happens when the Villain is pushed out of the last city space.

glossary.name: Fight
glossary.summary: An effect that happens when a player defeats the Villain or Mastermind Tactic that has it.

glossary.name: Master Strike
glossary.summary: A Villain Deck card that makes the Mastermind act, using that Mastermind's own Master Strike text.

glossary.name: Mastermind Tactic
glossary.summary: One of the Mastermind's four face-down cards. Defeating the Mastermind takes a Tactic and triggers its Fight effect.

glossary.name: Rescue a Bystander
glossary.summary: Take a Bystander from the Bystander Deck into your Victory Pile; each is worth a Victory Point.

glossary.name: Scheme Twist
glossary.summary: A Villain Deck card that advances the Scheme, as the Scheme card describes.

notes.text: Red Skull, Hydra Overlord adds a setup step: Optional: play the Epic side instead; the Tactics stay the same
